column1: # The Deep dive inventory: every mechanism in the code, user-facing or internal, mapped to the
# page that explains it. `site/scripts/check_deep_dive.py` (make docs-deep-dive) fails when a
# source file belongs to no topic, or a `written` topic has no page.
# Columns (tab-separated): slug, title, status (todo|written), comma-separated path globs.
# A page lives at docs/deep-dive/topics/<slug>.md. A file may belong to several topics.

column2: Listeners: accept loops, SO_REUSEPORT and port ranges
UDP: session tables, recvmmsg batching and the amplification guard
The TCP byte pump: splice, draining and connection tracking
Immutable snapshots and hot reload
Pools, balancers and runtime backend edits
Active and passive health checks
PROXY protocol and transparent mode
The filter chain: ACLs, GeoIP, rate limits and caps
Runtime feature flags and kill switches
Route matching: CIDR sets, SNI peeking and route hints
External resolvers: HTTP and gRPC with a result cache
WASM sniffers: the sandbox, the ABI and the loader
Backend discovery: DNS SRV, Consul, Kubernetes and static
Regional health: a SWIM gossip fabric
The admin API
Metrics, connection logs and error types
The config schema: parsing, validation and versioning
Secrets: the sealed store, references and redaction
The backend tunnel on the proxy side
wayhouse-agent: WireGuard on the origin side
The tunnel registry: leases, addresses and origins
The controller: store, roles and the API shell
Controller HA: Raft, snapshots and membership
Config distribution: intents, canaries and confirm windows
Enrollment: join codes, step-up approvals and scoped tokens
Stored UI data: dashboards, themes and filters
Certificates: ACME issuance, renewal and distribution
Plugins: the WASM host, capabilities and bounds
Plugins in the controller: timers, events, hooks and routes
The aggregator: fleet reads, history and fan-out
The UI backend: sessions, auth and proxying
The UI frontend
The web gateway: Caddy, wayhouse-web-sync and site rendering
The shared HTTP toolkit: bearer auth, TLS, SSE and policy
Registries, signing and the release feed
The all-in-one control process
The CI pipeline
Releases: release-please, images and signing
Container images, Compose, Kubernetes and systemd
The documentation site
Fleet tests, benchmarks, fuzzing and load tests
Process settings: editing launch flags from the UI with a trial and undo
